feeds.title: Gallery Night Blog
feeds.description: Gallery Night Providence is an arts nonprofit that opens the doors to Providence art galleries on the third Thursday of every month from March through November, with the goal of making the arts accessible to all. Check out their blog for interviews with artists, stories from our galleries, tidbits from events, and more!

feeds.title: Motif » Artwork
feeds.description: Unlock the best of local arts and entertainment. From cutting-edge galleries and thought-provoking exhibitions to electrifying live music performances and captivating film festivals, Motif's dedicated team of local writers and critics will keep you informed and inspired.

feeds.title: Rhode Island State Council on the Arts
feeds.description: Follow the latest updates and press releases from the Rhode Island State Council on the Arts. Established in 1967, the Rhode Island State Council on the Arts is charged by the state legislature to stimulate public interest and participation in the arts and to serve as the liaison to the state's arts community.

feeds.title: Melanie Ducharme
feeds.description: Melanie Ducharme's (she/her) work is a response to the world around her. The themes she works with are gender, identity, sexuality, memory, popular culture, and/or political issues. Her imagery frequently uses symbols that are traditionally associated with being female. In addition, many of her pieces use the human body, particularly the female body, as a symbol.

feeds.title: The Independent » Arts & Living
feeds.description: Embark on a journey that celebrates the myriad forms of artistic expression that grace our community. Within these pages of The Independent, you'll discover insightful features, thought-provoking critiques, and engaging interviews meant to foster a deeper appreciation for the arts and elevate the discourse surrounding local art element.

feeds.title: Sarah Z. Short Blog
feeds.description: Step into the whimsical world of abstract artist and printmaker, Sarah Z. Short, where the boundaries between reality and imagination blur. In her studio blog, Sarah invites you on a captivating journey through her creative process, offering a behind-the-scenes look at the making of her intricate collages and thought-provoking prints.

feeds.title: Blazing Editions
feeds.description: Delve into the intricate world of fine art printmaking and framing techniques with our comprehensive guides. Explore the rich history and diverse methods of printmaking, from the intricate lines of etchings and engravings to the bold colors of lithographs and screen prints. Blazing Editions is a leading custom fine art printmaker in North America.

feeds.title: Newport Art Museum News
feeds.description: Get up to date on all things Newport Art Museum. Written by a team of passionate art enthusiasts and industry experts, Newport Art Museum's news page offers an insightful and engaging exploration of the trends, controversies, and groundbreaking works that are shaping the artistic discourse.

feeds.title: Art, Culture and Tourism
feeds.description: The City of Providence Department of Art, Culture, and Tourism (ACT) strives for the continued development of a vibrant and creative city by integrating arts and culture into community life while showcasing Providence as an international cultural destination. Stay tuned for new announcements, press releases and other resources on this space.

feeds.title: Michael Rose Fine Art Blog
feeds.description: Michael Rose is a multi-talented fine art professional based in Southern New England. Since 2014 he has served as the gallery manager at the historic Providence Art Club, one of the nation's oldest arts organizations. Follow his artistic expressions, personal ramblings and Fine Arts updates here.

feeds.title: Jessica Shaffer Fine Art
feeds.description: Here is your gateway to the best hikes and spectacular ocean views hiking, biking, kayaking, and painting across Rhode Island and New England. Jessica Shaffer is an outdoors enthusiast and fine artist sharing the beauty of coastal living in the Ocean State.
